completion_decisions: Register the changing-wind robustness problem and random-position single-solution search as the target paper pair, not unrelated cited baselines.
Use the exact five alpha, beta and gamma values and 10000 complete feasible layout evaluations for each paper-native case.
Use the target-cited three-year, hub-height Table-1 wind parameters from DOI 10.3390/en8043075, not the older T60 Table-3 mast-height parameters.
Select the cited piecewise joint-PDF variant because T69 does not identify piecewise, linear or spline and its 35-parameter perturbation maps exactly to the sector form.
Use the T60-audited same-lineage Horns coordinates, boundary, Jensen model and pinned PyWake V80 curves.
Use one fixed counter-keyed 1000-scenario lambda-PDF bank and sample standard deviation for every layout and study case.
Preserve the literal Eq.4 missing-Jacobian VoP quadrature because it reproduces the paper's 1e-4 VoP order and cancels in short robustness ratios.
Report both paper-literal 8770-hour and calendar-correct 8760-hour AEP.
Execute both equation-declared beta=0.95 and Table-3-compatible beta=0.5 overall profiles because the paper's text and numeric table conflict.
Do not fabricate the unavailable three-year ten-minute time series or claim its ramp-standard-deviation replay.
Use exact O(360N) moved-turbine tensor updates, sector aggregation, persistent all-core direction/scenario parallelism and ordered deterministic commits.

machine-readable target Horns layout, boundary and V80 curves

paper.authors: Ju Feng and Wen Zhong Shen
paper.title: Wind Farm Power Production in the Changing Wind: Robustness Quantification and Layout Optimization

paper_source_conflicts: Eq.2 prints 8770 and calls it the total hours in a year.
Eq.4 retains the physical joint PDF after speed and direction nondimensionalization and omits the Jacobian.
Section 5 fixes beta=0.95, whereas Table 3 R_long=4.750 equals sqrt(78.54/3.482) and therefore beta=0.5.
The cited joint-wind paper defines piecewise, linear and spline PDFs, but T69 does not identify which variant produced its figures and tables.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of the complete changing-wind problem, robustness metrics, native sweeps and explicit conflict profiles; not author source, random state, unavailable time series or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: original Horns parallelogram and pairwise Euclidean spacing at least 5D=400m; infeasible random positions do not consume complete-layout FES

decision_variables.resolution: 160 continuous coordinates for 80 identical V80-2MW turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct continuous x,y coordinates without a grid decoder

initialization.resolution: pinned public Horns Rev 1 10-by-8 source layout

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: mean power, literal/calendar AEP, VoP, long mean/std, three robustness metrics, all layouts, FES, proposals, accepts, timings, workers and hash; one run per case because no independent repeat count is stated

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize short, long or weighted overall robustness; execute both declared and Table-3-compatible overall semantics

paper_native_cases.resolution: five alpha, five beta and five gamma roles at 0,0.05,0.5,0.95,1 plus five separately labelled equation-declared gamma conflict roles

parameters.resolution: lambda=1, VA=0.2, Vc=0.1, Vf=0.5, 1000 scenarios, 360 directions, integer speeds 3..25m/s, 80 turbines and 5D spacing

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 10000 complete feasible robustness evaluations including the initial layout for each case

update_order.resolution: select one turbine and one uniformly random affine position; reject infeasible; evaluate feasible; strict improvement commits in trajectory order

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen partial-overlap RSS deficits and V80 speed-dependent power/Ct over the complete 360-by-23 power surface

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: exact hub-height three-year Table-1 parameters, piecewise joint PDF and fixed counter-keyed 1000-scenario parameter perturbation bank

development_h6_20260731.work: 1000 physical evaluations for each short, long and overall objective
development_h6_20260731.comparison_boundary: same pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB or author-code comparison
